items.name: color-input
items.title: Color input
items.description: Swatch, hex text field and native colour picker kept in sync inside a Field. Typed hex (3 or 6 digits, # optional) is normalised to #rrggbb on blur; invalid text is flagged and restored. On fine pointers the swatch opens a popover (swatches, hex, system picker, EyeDropper where available); a partial hex dithers the swatch; form reset restores the default.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Value is always lower-case #rrggbb. The swatch is the visible face of the native picker, which keeps its own accessible name (pickerLabel). Migration (v4): on a fine pointer the native input is no longer the click target (it stays in the form, pointer-events none, aria-hidden); a trigger button opens the popover and its "시스템 선택기" button calls showPicker(). Coarse pointers keep the native picker. New prop `swatches`. Tests that look up the picker by label must add `{ selector: "input[type=color]" }` (the trigger button carries the same name). A hex that is still partial shows a yorha-dither-50 layer and commits nothing. Reset events on the owning form restore the default value.
